from pathlib import Path
import collections
work=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace')

prog.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Translate all cells one row downward, keeping the original dimensions.
    # The new top row uses the dominant background color; cells shifted past
    # the bottom edge are discarded.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(1, h):
        out[r] = list(grid[r-1])
    return out
'''
